iconiq-growth._readme: Identity merges for ICONIQ Growth. Two sources of duplication: the filing layers name a company by its registered name while the firm's grid uses the brand (AgileBits / 1Password, Appboy / Braze, Unite USA / Unite Us), and the firm's own surfaces rendered one company two ways across site generations (The Honest Company on the 2020-2026 grid vs Honest Company on the DatoCMS and live grids; Tencent Music on the grid vs TME on the 2022 per-company pages). Canonical is the rendering on the firm's live grid, else the longest-running archive rendering. Written 2026-09-29 after the first build and before any judged verdict; the base was rebuilt on it the same hour. Added 2026-09-29 before any verdict: Smile Family / SendBird and DYN365 / Restaurant365 (registered names found by EDGAR's name history). Added 2026-09-29 in the valuation pass: Nintex / Skuid (the grid's renamed panel), Intercom / Fin and People.ai / Backstory (renames in 2026).

merges.reason: AgileBits Inc. is 1Password's registered name (Form D naming Will Griffith; the firm led 1Password's Series C of January 2022, its post of 2022-01-19).
Appboy, Inc. renamed itself Braze in 2017; the Form D names Doug Pepper and Matthew Jacobson.
Unite USA Inc. is Unite Us's registered name (Form D naming Caroline Xie).
The firm's 2020-2026 grid renders The Honest Company, its live and DatoCMS grids Honest Company: one company (honest.com).
TME is the firm's 2022 per-company page (/company/tme/) for Tencent Music Entertainment, which its grids render Tencent Music (tencentmusic.com).
Smile Family, Inc. (CIK 1724032, San Mateo) is SendBird, Inc. under its name until 2019-05-06 (EDGAR formerNames); its 2019 Form Ds name Matthew Jacobson and Douglas Pepper as directors.
DYN365, Inc. (CIK 1727596, 7 Bendix, Irvine) is Restaurant365's registered name; its Form D of 2019-06-28 records the $88.0M round and names Will Griffith as a director.

The live grid's Nintex panel links to skuid.com: it is the Skuid panel renamed after Nintex bought Skuid in December 2023 (Skuid on the grid 2020 to January 2026). ICONIQ's company is Skuid; the acquirer is not a member (decisions.md R5; Insight's R10 reads the panel the same way).
Intercom renamed itself Fin in 2026 (Salesforce's release of 2026-06-15: 'Fin, formerly Intercom'); the live grid shows Fin (fin.ai), the 2020-2026 archives Intercom (decisions.md R5).

People.ai renamed itself Backstory on 2026-04-21 (the company's newsroom, https://www.backstory.ai/newsroom/people-ai-becomes-backstory-redefining-how-revenue-teams-get-answers-about-their-deals); the live grid shows Backstory, the 2020-2026 archives People.ai.
